tweet.text: I vibe-coded this browser game today in about 2 hours using Claude Code. It is a free roam around a coastal city, which Claude Opus 5.5 designed and encoded in just a few thousand lines of JavaScript code. Pelicans on bicycles are fun, this is just bananas.
